values.name: Additional identification
values.description: Information which specifies and qualifies product identifications.

values.name: Identification for potential substitution
values.description: The item number describes the potential substitute product.

values.name: Substituted by
values.description: The given item number is the number of the product that substitutes another one.

values.name: Substituted for
values.description: The given item number is the number of the original product substituted by another.

values.name: Product identification
values.description: The item number is for product identification.

values.name: Successor product id
values.description: Product id of the product that will follow the one currently in production/trade.

values.name: Predecessor product id
values.description: Product id of the predecessor of the product currently in production/trade.

values.name: Expired/out of production
values.description: The given item number is the expired item number of the product. It has been replaced.

values.name: Deletion of secondary identification
values.description: Code indicating the deletion of a secondary identification.

values.name: Alternate product identification
values.description: Alternate number to identify the product.
